candidate.title: G&T-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina G&T-Seq schematic: isolation and lysis of one cell, bead capture and physical separation of poly(A) mRNA from genomic DNA, on-bead Smart-seq2 transcriptome amplification and a separate MDA genome-amplification branch, followed by sequencing and association of the two readouts. G&T-seq and Genome and Transcriptome Sequencing are aliases of this one target. Smart-seq2 and MDA are named components. This is the depicted MDA implementation, not a claim that all G&T-Seq implementations use MDA. The far-left cell/RNA/DNA icon is an explanatory target inset. The listed scM&T-seq adaptation and associated library kits are not additional depicted workflows. Original Macaulay primary-paper evidence supplied here is abstract-only; named chemistry is supported by the diagram and catalogue.

operations.label: Streptavidin magnetic bead with mRNA capture primer
operations.description: Capture the poly(A)-bearing RNA from the lysate on primer-bearing beads; the DNA is retained as the unbound material at this stage.
operations.mechanism: RNA poly(A) hybridizes to oligo(dT); biotinylated capture primer is associated with the streptavidin-coated magnetic bead.

method_scopes.rationale: All nine local operations belong to the sole schematic target G&T-Seq. Upper and lower Sequence captions are represented as separate instances because their substrates remain separate. The final alignment/integration consumes data from both branches, as clarified by the catalogue. Collection page 118 was checked: its heading is G&T-Seq: Genome and Transcriptome Sequencing and its figure caption is A schematic overview of G&T-seq. The page discusses scM&T-seq under a separate reference summary, which does not expand this schematic's target. The original primary abstract establishes paired full-length mRNA/genomic DNA separation and sequencing, while figure/catalogue evidence establishes the Smart-seq2/MDA route. The related full text is used narrowly for the inherited G&T separation and cDNA interpretation of the RNA interface.

evidence.quote: Smart-seq2 is used to amplify captured RNA on the bead, while multiple displacement amplification (MDA) is used to amplify DNA.
